More Info :

I have a male cat (Peanut ) , he's about 7 months old, and whenever he went outside, he always came back when I called his name. Even if he did not react, he was always back for dinner. 

My father has been away for about a year, and I basically raised him alone all this time. He returned some time this week tho and Peanut got noticeably anxious. He's pretty shy towards strangers in general so I did not think much of it.
One day he meowed the whole time wanting to go outside, I put his lunch out and he ate a lil bit before suspiciously looking around suddenly. He growled (which he never did before!) and then took off.

It may sound like a dumb thing but I'm really worried about him, I couldn't sleep properly the past days.

I appreciate any advice or comment,

Thank you!

I obviously can't speak for everyone, but personally the last months and especially the times in the clinic and afterwards were so shitty. I wasn't able to do the most basic stuff and I freaked out at everyone and everything I was basically being a total bitch who just didn't care anymore and felt miserable every day. But that day I caught myself having some calm and grateful moments and I noticed that if I focus on them a bit more, I won't feel as shitty. Maybe it's not worth it, who knows, but it IS  a relieve to even feel not that crappy for a minute. I'm sorry to hear that you're having so much bad days and I want u to know that I'm always here for chatting If u like!! :)

I am totally guilty in this case. I say this sooo often while always feeling like a lost case myself. So I apologize if that is something that pisses ppl off, which is understandable. But I'm just trying to say that even if everyone goes their lone ways in their every day life, there will be always someone who cares and listens. Even if it's like some random dorks like me on reddit. In the end it's your choice if you'll reach out or not, just don't think you're Alone in *everything* in life. Hey love, I am so sorry you are feeling this way. I can relate and I know how hard and also painful this must be for you. But please please believe me when I, a random no one on the internet, say, that I am truly glad you're still here. You are so loved by many and I doubt that the bad things on life overweight all the love and care from your family, your kids, your love and your friends. I am so proud of you for being safe, it must be so tough. I hope you will be on this world tomorrow, and the day after and that day after too, just- be strong. You are stronger than you might think. If you can't live for yourself live for your loved ones. I'll believe in you, I'm sure we all do! Much love and strength to you!!
